title: Tacoma vs Ranger vs Colorado for 2027: The Winner Changes in Every Round
description:
Toyota Tacoma vs Ford Ranger vs Chevrolet Colorado for 2026-2027, in six rounds: sales, price, power, towing, reliability and safety, plus the 350-hp 2027 Colorado and the trucks most buyers forget. Every number comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
2:00 Round 1: Sales
4:10 Round 2: Price
7:29 Round 3: Power
10:08 Round 4: Towing and payload
11:30 Round 5: Reliability
15:26 Round 6: Safety
17:40 Frontier, Gladiator, Ridgeline and Dakota
19:59 Which one to buy
21:06 The verdict
